messages:
kevin: Heads-up — we're seeing ~0.7% of requests with missing project_org claim after the new routing change. Does eng-platform own the telemetry here or should Console/product own the 'effective identity' surface? cc @maya @oliver
ops-bot: Alert: auth-routing-mismatch rate spike 0.68% over 15m at 1791112210
maya: Platform should own ingestion/metrics + the canonical mapping. Console can own UX display. We need a single canonical metric: auth.identity.mismatch{route,model}.
oliver: Agree split. Also need sample payloads with headers — console can't show what's not recorded. Can we log `x-origin: org=org-123;proj=proj-456;sa=svc-789`? Minimal PII.
sam: Propose rollout: 0.1% full payload sampling -> store in S3 for 7d -> dashboard to validate. Feature flag: ff.authn.mismatch_payload_sampling. Also need privacy review.
kevin: SG. Metrics to add: mismatch_rate, fallback_model_count, sampling_rate. Who wires the dashboard? Eng-platform owns metric and endpoint; Product owns dashboard tiles + event description.
maya: I'll add instrumentation PR and produce sample config. Snippet:
```yaml
sampling:
  enabled: true
  rate: 0.001
  fields: [x-origin, x-exchange, route_id]
```
oliver: UX note: console should show 'Effective identity' with small badge, tooltip explaining fallback. Keep it collapsed by default.
sam: Operational runbook: if mismatch_rate > 0.5% and spike sustains 10m, route-rollout -> rollback; paging to @oncall. I'll draft.
kevin: Plan: maya PR tomorrow, deploy to staging w/ sample 0.1%; add dashboard panel; two-week canary: 0.1%->1%->10%. Filing task: PLAT-7823 :thumbsup:
maya: Ack; will start PR + link when ready :eyes:
